name: AI Pulse
title: AI Pulse: Agents Start Doing the Work

items.gist: AI agents now control part of DeepMind's compute for Gemini experiments, but recursive self-improvement is still distant.
Simon Willison, NVIDIA, Matthew Berman and AI Explained shared views on agents, open source, AI risk and the model race.
Anthropic's Claude Ship lets AI agents review, fix and approve code changes, mainly for engineering teams.
Salesforce and Reddit show AI agents changing shopping and ad growth, while Jeff Su shares plugins for office work.

name: Law & Tender Desk
title: Law & Tender Desk: Who Counts as the Manufacturer?

items.gist: A specialist article asks whether manufacturer means the owner or the production plant; MMH should check that MANI and MMG bid files name both exactly, and the full decision is still needed.
The law has passed, but the effective date and benefit-list details are not in our notes, so the full text must be read before any price or bid change.

items.topic: Overdue equipment debts in Lam Dong
items.gist: A provincial inspection team now looks at unpaid equipment bills, a sign of late payment that hits distributors first; MMH should review Lam Dong payment terms.
A series from the American Academy of Ophthalmology suggests more phaco kits per visit; it is guidance rather than trial proof, so sales should ask eye hospitals about same-day lists.

name: The Clinic Room
title: The Clinic Room: Inside a cataract operation, step by step

items.gist: Dr. Sarah explained the cataract steps: a small incision with an ophthalmic knife, phaco to break the lens, a clear implant, and closing the wound, with micro forceps holding fine tissue throughout.
Glaucoma damages the optic nerve when eye pressure stays high because the drainage mesh blocks; trabeculotomy opens that drain with the Trabeculotomy Hook, so a precise, sharp tip matters.
Root canal cleaning uses JIZAI nickel titanium files that bend with the canal; DIA-BURS prepare the tooth and Mani Bond bonds the composite. Next time, follow up on how dental clinics choose files.

name: Law & Tender Desk
title: Law & Tender Desk: Hospital buying freedom and new insurance dates

items.gist: Hospitals get more room to choose chemical and equipment suppliers, so MMH sales must work with clinical departments and may need local price logic; the official text and start date still need checking.
Resolution 48 extends premium support for ethnic minorities, and the amended social insurance law takes effect March first, twenty twenty-seven, so hospital budgets for next year need review.

Decree 418 starts January fifth, twenty twenty-seven for voluntary work accident insurance, and Decree 417 changes customs rules for e-commerce imports; follow up on the Japan import cost and surgical demand.
Resolution 402 prioritises five regions for hospital and infrastructure investment, so MMH should watch those regions for new tender notices for dental and eye equipment.
